Seedance 2.5 prompt 👇

Duration: 25 seconds
Aspect ratio: 16:9 landscape
Character references:
@ 
 female lead, 
@
 male lead
Language: no dialogue, no narration
Text: no subtitles
Audio: tense ambiguous music, rain sounds, traffic sounds, three slap sounds, rapid breathing, fabric rustling

GLOBAL CONTINUITY

Female lead:
Use

 Lock the adult female lead's facial features, face shape, skin tone and identity. Wearing a black high-neck slim-fit dress. Stubborn, cold personality, clearly resisting when the male lead approaches.

Male lead:
Use

 Lock the adult male lead's facial features, face shape, skin tone and identity. Black short hair combed back, wearing a black textured suit, black shirt. Gradually losing restraint after being slapped.

Driver:
Middle-aged male, black chauffeur uniform, white gloves. Only briefly appears in the rearview mirror, does not speak, does not turn his head.

Scene:
A black luxury stretch limousine driving on a rainy night. Black leather rear seats, dark wood-grain interior, starlight ceiling, warm reading lights. Car windows covered in raindrops, blue and red neon streaking past outside at high speed.

Overall performance:
A high-conflict romance micro-drama performed by adult actors. The three slaps must be real and clear, the male lead's head must turn in the direction of the force; the kiss, lip bite, separation and approaching again must have clear cause and effect. All pulling and tugging is safe performance, the male lead's palms only grip the jaw and the back of the neck, do not squeeze the throat.

SHOT 1 (00:00-00:02.00) Attempted kiss and first slap

00:00-00:00.70
The male lead sits to the female lead's left, slowly leaning toward her, gaze dropping from her eyes to her lips. The female lead leans back slightly, eyes cold, right hand starting to rise.

00:00.70-00:01.10
The male lead closes his eyes and continues to lean in, but his lips have not yet touched the female lead.

The female lead suddenly swings her right hand, a slap accurately hitting the male lead's left cheek.

Action order:
Right shoulder drives the arm → right palm contacts the male lead's left cheek → crisp slap sound → the male lead's head snaps to the right.

00:01.10-00:02.00
The female lead quickly retracts her right hand, staring coldly at the male lead. The male lead holds the head-turned pose for half a second, then slowly turns back, brow bone lowered, expression shifting from shock to anger.

Camera:
In-car two-person medium close-up, fully capturing the female lead's arm trajectory and the male lead's reaction to the force. Forbidden to use blur or flash-to-white to cover the slap.

SHOT 2 (00:02.00-00:06.00) First forced kiss and lip bite

00:02.00-00:02.70
After turning back, the male lead suddenly closes in, one hand gripping the back of the female lead's neck, the other grabbing her shoulder, pulling her toward him.

The female lead presses both hands against the male lead's chest, trying to keep distance.

00:02.70-00:04.20
The male lead kisses the female lead. The female lead's body is tense, palms continuously pushing against the male lead's chest; the male lead maintains the controlling grip on the back of the neck and shoulder.

00:04.20-00:04.80
Amid the struggle, the female lead suddenly bites the male lead's lower lip. The male lead's brow suddenly tightens, and he immediately pulls back from the pain.

00:04.80-00:06.00
The two separate. A little dark red blood appears on the male lead's lower lip and mouth corner, only a small amount of seeping blood. The female lead breathes rapidly, still glaring at him angrily. Neither touches or examines the wound.

Camera:
First present the struggle in a two-person close-up, then cut to a side close-up that clearly shows the bite on the lower lip. No tongue close-ups.

SHOT 3 (00:06.00-00:08.50) Second slap

00:06.00-00:06.60
The male lead, with a small amount of blood at the corner of his mouth, approaches the female lead again. The female lead winds up her left shoulder backward, left hand quickly rising.

00:06.60-00:07.10
The female lead slaps the male lead's right cheek with her left hand.

Action order:
Left arm swings horizontally → left palm contacts the male lead's right cheek → second slap sound → the male lead's head is knocked to the left.

00:07.10-00:08.50
The male lead's head turns left, pausing about 0.7 seconds. He slowly turns back, still with a bit of blood at the corner of his mouth, eyes growing colder.

The female lead's left hand stops at her chest, body pressed against the seat, staying guarded.

Camera:
Fixed two-person medium shot, the second slap must be in the opposite direction from the first slap.

SHOT 4 (00:08.50-00:12.00) Second forced kiss and third slap

00:08.50-00:09.20
The male lead suddenly reaches out, one hand gripping the back of the female lead's neck, the other supporting her chin, turning her toward him. Palms must not press the throat.

00:09.20-00:10.70
The male lead kisses the female lead again. The action is faster and more forceful than the first time. The female lead grabs the male lead's collar with both hands, body pressing back against the seat, then forcefully struggles free to the side.

00:10.70-00:11.10
The female lead successfully turns her face away, lips separating. Her right hand is already raised, the male lead still in a leaning-forward pose.

00:11.10-00:11.60
The female lead swings her right hand a third time, slapping the male lead's left cheek again.

Action order:
Right hand sweeps quickly → palm hits left cheek → third slap sound → the male lead's head turns to the right again.

00:11.60-00:12.00
The male lead's movement stops, face turned to the right. The female lead retracts her right hand, leaning against the seat breathing rapidly.

Constraints:
The third slap must occur after the second kiss ends, cannot slap while kissing, cannot omit the action of lips separating.

SHOT 5 (00:12.00-00:13.50) Driver reaction

Camera:
Cut to the front driver's cabin and the in-car rearview mirror.

The driver holds the steering wheel with both hands, continuing to watch the road. He briefly moves his gaze upward, sees the two people in the back seat through the rearview mirror, eyebrows slightly raised, showing a very faint amused grin, then immediately looks back at the road ahead.

The driver does not speak, does not turn his head, does not change the vehicle speed.

In the rearview mirror, the male lead can be vaguely seen approaching the female lead again, but this must not steal the focus of the driver's shot.

SHOT 6 (00:13.50-00:25.00) Final long kiss

00:13.50-00:14.50
Cut back to the rear seat. The male lead and female lead look at each other in silence. The male lead has a slight red mark on his cheek, a small amount of blood still at the corner of his mouth.

The male lead reaches out to support the female lead's chin, forcing her to lift her face; the other hand goes around to the back of the female lead's neck. The female lead's brow tightens, both hands pressing against the male lead's chest.

00:14.50-00:15.30
The male lead slowly approaches. The distance between their lips shrinks from ten centimeters to full contact.

The female lead first looks at the male lead with open eyes, and only closes her eyes after contact.

00:15.30-00:19.00
The final kiss begins. The male lead supports the back of the female lead's head with one hand, the other supporting her shoulder and back; the female lead still grips the fabric on the male lead's chest with both hands.

The kiss is continuous and uninterrupted. The car body sways slightly going through a curve, the two lean closer with inertia.

00:19.00-00:22.00
The two naturally adjust their head angle once, but lips remain in contact. The male lead's movements gradually become steady from forceful; the female lead's shoulders gradually relax, the fingers gripping the suit no longer pushing away with force.

Camera:
Slowly orbit from a right-side close-up to a left-side close-up, always keeping both parties' hands and faces in frame, cannot shoot only the lips.

00:22.00-00:25.00
The camera slowly pulls out through the rain-covered car window to outside the car. The black sedan drives on the rainy-night elevated road, and inside the rear window the silhouettes of the two embracing and kissing can still be seen.

The final kiss lasts from 15.3 seconds to 25 seconds, about 9.7 seconds, not separating until the last frame.

PERFORMANCE CONSTRAINTS

- Exactly three slaps in the whole film, no fewer, no more.
- First slap: female lead's right hand hits male lead's left cheek.
- Second slap: female lead's left hand hits male lead's right cheek.
- Third slap: female lead's right hand hits male lead's left cheek again.
- The first slap occurs when the male lead is about to kiss but has not yet made contact.
- After the first slap the male lead kisses back, the female lead bites the male lead's lower lip.
- After the lip bite only a little blood appears at the male lead's mouth corner.
- After the second slap the second kiss occurs.
- The third slap occurs only after the second kiss ends.
- The driver shot is after the third slap.
- The final kiss continues to the end of the film.
- All people are adults.
- The back-of-neck control only expresses a dominant posture, palms must not squeeze the throat or cause suffocation.

Negative:
Any subtitles, any on-screen text, narration, dialogue, only one slap, only two slaps, a fourth slap appearing, wrong slap order, wrong left/right hand, wrong side of face hit, slap missing, female lead caressing male lead's face, female lead wiping blood, examining the wound, male lead kissing the female lead on the first try, omitting the first attempted-but-failed kiss, omitting the lip bite, female lead biting her own lip, heavy bleeding, spurting blood, no separation before the second slap, third slap occurring after the driver shot, final kiss too short, final kiss ending early, mechanical kissing, lips merging, nose clipping, mouth opening too wide, choking the throat, suffocation action, face swap, male and female leads' identities swapped, driver sitting in the back seat, driver continuously turning his head back, driverless car, in-car space changing, static outside the window, extra arms, extra fingers, subtitles, watermark, Logo
